ORDER_STATUS_TRACKING.description: Inquiries regarding package location, dispatch status, tracking links, and estimated delivery dates.
ORDER_STATUS_TRACKING.route_reason: Solvable via automated tracking link lookups and dispatch status summaries.

DELIVERY_DELAY_COMPLAINT.description: Complaints that an order is late, missed guaranteed delivery date, or stuck in transit.
DELIVERY_DELAY_COMPLAINT.route_reason: Can provide carrier delay policy and self-serve re-delivery or carrier inquiry steps.

RETURN_REFUND_REQUEST.description: Requests for returning items, tracking refund credit to bank, return labels, or pickup scheduling.
RETURN_REFUND_REQUEST.route_reason: Standard automated return authorization, return center link, and refund SLA (3-5 business days).

DIGITAL_KINDLE_PRIME_STREAMING.description: Issues with Prime Video playback, Kindle device/books, Amazon Music, or digital subscriptions.
DIGITAL_KINDLE_PRIME_STREAMING.route_reason: Can provide standard digital troubleshooting steps (app cache, license refresh, device re-registration).

ACCOUNT_LOGIN_SECURITY.description: Account lockouts, OTP/2FA failures, unrecognized transactions, password reset, or hacked accounts.
ACCOUNT_LOGIN_SECURITY.route_reason: Requires authenticated account verification and credential security protocol by human specialist.

DAMAGED_DEFECTIVE_ITEM.description: Reports of damaged goods, broken packaging, defective items, or incorrect item received.
DAMAGED_DEFECTIVE_ITEM.route_reason: Can direct to automated replacement flow or replacement order generation without manual agent if within window.

PAYMENT_BILLING_INQUIRY.description: Inquiries about double charges, payment failures, gift card balance, or declined cards.
PAYMENT_BILLING_INQUIRY.route_reason: Can clarify billing hold policies and provide bank reconciliation timelines before escalation.

GENERAL_POLICY_FEEDBACK.description: Customer feedback, complaints about customer service reps, seller behavior, or broad store policies.
GENERAL_POLICY_FEEDBACK.route_reason: Subjective complaint or high-friction dispute requiring personalized human de-escalation.
